title: How I made a laser-eyes game in UE5 for the Epic AI MegaJam with Claude Code
author: Al-Cohol0802
selftext:
I made CUT ON SIGHT solo for the Epic AI MegaJam in Unreal 5.8 (C++).

The theme was Director's Cut, so I started from the word "cut". My first idea was a samurai game, but after thinking it over, laser eyes felt like the most fitting and most intuitive way to cut: you look at something and it splits. The tracing comes from Magic Touch: Wizard for Hire, a Nitrome mobile game I played as a kid where you draw the shape on each balloon to pop it. Here the guards wear laser-proof armor, and you trace the seam pattern on each one to cut through.

Claude Code wrote the code; I did the design, the direction and the playtesting. I tried rules in small three.js web pages first, because a browser page reloads in a second. The Unreal version was built in the last 36 hours of the jam. Nothing in it is hand-placed: rooms, enemies and materials are generated from code and Python scripts. Claude also wrote a headless self-test that boots the game and runs 93 checks, and it ran after every change.

Sound effects and the intro voice are ElevenLabs through fal.ai. The three intro comic panels are Nano Banana.
